title: Implement OSCORE ctx lookup, unprotect, and CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE enforcement for LCI mutating ops
description: Add OSCORE authorization (context lookup + unprotect) for /msg/inbox POST, keys, deaddrop. Update enforcement in relevant handlers.
